root_cause: The datepicker hides on blur when focus leaves the input. When focus moves to another field in the same form (e.g., guests), the datepicker still hides after a timeout, causing focus to unexpectedly return to the input field.
repair_strategy: Modify _onInputBlur to keep the datepicker open when the active element remains within the same form, preventing premature hide and focus return.
expected_accessibility_effect: After typing a date and pressing Tab, focus will move to the guests field and stay there, allowing uninterrupted form completion.
functional_risks: Datepicker may remain open when tabbing to other fields in the same form, potentially obscuring underlying fields.
Users who rely on automatic closing when navigating away via keyboard may experience delayed closure.
verification_requirements: After typing a date and pressing Tab, focus moves to the guests field and remains there.
Datepicker still hides when clicking outside the input or selecting a date.
Keyboard month/year navigation continues to work.
Pointer-based month paging retains focus in the date field (regression guard).
